title: 瑞银Adrian：80%财富困在地产，消费信心怎么起
speaker: Adrian Zuercher

segments.en: What's going to be that catalyst, though? I wonder. Well, they probably caught, I mean, first of all, China has to do well again.
segments.zh: 那催化剂会是什么呢？我在想。嗯，他们可能抓住了，我的意思是，首先，中国得再次表现良好。

segments.en: And to do it well, we have to see that consumer confidence coming back.
segments.zh: 而要表现良好，我们必须看到消费者信心回升。

segments.en: And consumer confidence coming back once the real estate cycle is turning.
segments.zh: 消费者信心会在房地产周期转向后回升。

segments.en: And 80% of the wealth of Chinese consumers is trapped in properties and probably surprised decline.
segments.zh: 中国消费者80%的财富困在房地产中，而且可能意外下降。

segments.en: So it's very difficult to create this positive feedback loop.
segments.zh: 所以很难形成这种正向反馈循环。

segments.en: And that has, of course, an effect to that some of these AI-related companies they've very domestically focused on revenues.
segments.zh: 当然，这对一些AI相关公司有影响，它们的收入非常依赖国内市场。

segments.en: And all that sort of plays a role on how sustainable basically that upward trend is, which at the moment said it's not much there.
segments.zh: 所有这些都影响着基本面上行趋势的可持续性，目前来看动力不足。

segments.en: And so we probably need just better growth, better news flow to unlock that value that we actually see.
segments.zh: 所以我们可能需要更好的增长、更好的消息面来释放我们实际看到的价值。

segments.en: How should I frame my portfolio for the fourth quarter now, right?
segments.zh: 现在我应该如何为第四季度构建我的**组合？
